answer: The Verified email inbox bound by callback verification with annual re-verification makes the identity prove its channel on demand: the verified email inbox answers a fresh challenge, the callback verification is recorded, and annual re-verification keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a rented or borrowed channel cannot quietly serve ten identities. Trust here is built the way a pigment is built: slowly, binding by binding, and easy to lose. No mesa is counted twice and no oasis is skipped: the ledger reconciles every binding.
